idea.title: Night Tank Forge
idea.hook: Build a cursed block tank before each wave, then drive into the dark and keep its lamp alive while infected modules crack and enemies swarm.
idea.hook_ru: Соберите проклятый блочный танк перед волной, затем выезжайте в темноту и удерживайте свет лампы, пока модули трескаются от заражения.
idea.prototype: Forge-and-survive loop: place tank modules, start a night wave, aim a protective light cone, earn scrap, repair damage, and deepen the build through persistent upgrades.
idea.mutation_of: Tank Forge / blocky vehicle builder / arena survival
idea.why_novel: The tank is both the build puzzle and the health bar: damaged or infected blocks change the silhouette and survival odds between waves.
idea.non_timer_pressure: Enemy swarms, corruption, module damage, repair costs, and wave escalation create pressure without a pure countdown.
idea.lose_condition: The run fails when the forged tank loses too many critical modules during a night wave.

sources.title: Tank Forge / horror direction
sources.snippet: Actually the tanks we are working on is kindof ... Maybe make horror

synthesizer_brief: Promoted from Tim's June 19 prototype critique as the strongest of the current batch. Publish path is blocky tank construction plus horror survival, not generic brainrot reskin.
